The first release of ReTzar, a fan remake of **Tzar: The Burden of the Crown**, rebuilt from scratch in Rust and Bevy and kept as close to the original as possible.

![A castle, an army and a walled town](https://github.com/ColCarlo/ReTzar/raw/main/screenshots/1-castle-and-army.jpg)

## How to play

1. Download the **zip** under Assets below and unzip it somewhere of yours, such as the Desktop or Documents.
2. Run **ReTzar.exe** in the `ReTzar` folder.
3. The first time, choose the folder where Tzar is installed (GOG, Steam or CD, any language). ReTzar checks it and makes its game data from it in about a minute; after that it starts straight away.

Windows may say that it protected your PC, since the game isn't signed: click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

## What's in it

- All three civilizations, the original campaigns and missions, random maps
- The original AI, mission scripts, day and night, weather, fog of war
- Crisp scaling up to 4K and seven languages: English, Italian, French, German, Spanish, Polish, Portuguese
- Optional modern extras (smooth zoom, night lights, glow of fire and magic, CRT effect…), all off by default

## What you need

- Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) and a graphics card with an up-to-date Vulkan driver
- Your own copy of Tzar: no game data is included
- About 350 MB of free disk space

Single player only. ReTzar is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with the makers of Tzar.
